# Objectives

- Deliver a comprehensive Lead-to-AUM and Customer Acquisition Cost data model and reporting suite that provides granular insights into pipeline performance and marketing return on investment.
- Achieve full automation of data ingestion, transformation, and reporting refresh processes to support efficient and timely analytics.
- Enable leadership to gain a detailed understanding of the journey from lead generation to AUM conversion and the effectiveness of marketing spend.
- Enhance user experience with improved Power BI dashboards featuring clear KPI definitions and actionable visualizations.
- Strengthen pipeline reporting and customer acquisition cost tracking to support data-driven decision making across teams.
- Establish scalable reporting capabilities that can accommodate future data sources and evolving business requirements.
- Ensure seamless integration of the data platform with Salesforce, QuickBooks, Tamarac, and Microsoft Fabric to enable unified analysis and reporting.
